huangpu-cotton-exchange-building-preview.observation: The complete south front, west corner tower, roof recesses, parapets and flagstaff are in frame.

museum-iron-gate.png.observation: The two Ionic columns frame the recessed grille, its two oval medallions and the split central disk. Seven raised gold characters are inset above the gate.

southwest-cupola.png.observation: Open slots separate the eight columns. The oculi have dark visible recesses below the dome and staff.

viewer-mobile-full.png.observation: The long southern facade and corner lantern both fit within the 390 pixel phone view. The gate inscription requires the detail view.
